title: COIG-P: A High-Quality and Large-Scale Chinese Preference Dataset for Alignment with Human Values
authors_zh: Siwei Wu、Jincheng Ren、Xinrun Du、Shuyue Guo、Xingwei Qu、Yiming Liang、Jie Liu、Yunwen Li、Tyler Loakman、Tianyu Zheng、Boyu Feng、Huaqing Yuan、Zenith Wang、Jiaheng Liu、Wenhao Huang、Chenglin Cai、Haoran Que、Jian Yang、Yuelin Bai、Zekun Moore Wang、Zhouliang Yu、Qunshu Lin、Ding Pan、Yuchen Jiang、Tiannan Wang、Wangchunshu Zhou、Shenzhi Wang、Xingyuan Bu、Minghao Liu、Guoyin Wang、Ge Zhang、Chenghua Lin
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈审计研究者
one_line: COIG-P releases Chinese chosen/rejected pairs across six task domains, using multi-model generation and judging to make preference optimization resources available at million-pair scale.
COIG-P 发布覆盖六类任务的中文 chosen/rejected 对，通过多模型生成与评审提供百万级偏好优化资源。
why: About one million Chinese chosen/rejected pairs across six domains, generated and judged by multiple LLMs.
inclusion_reason: About one million Chinese chosen/rejected pairs across six domains, generated and judged by multiple LLMs.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Chinese preference resources have been limited by scale, domain coverage, and data validation, while human annotation constrains expansion. COIG-P addresses how to construct Chinese chosen/rejected supervision at a scale suitable for preference optimization and reward modeling without using human intervention in the pipeline. Its decision boundary is the ranking of generated candidate responses for Chinese queries, not a claim that the chosen response is universally truthful or aligned with every human value.

The paper targets Chinese alignment and Chinese reward models across diverse tasks. The relevant data surface is a Chinese query, candidate responses, chosen/rejected labels, domain information, and quality-control metadata. It does not establish that synthetic LLM judgments are equivalent to direct human preference, nor that the resource covers every Chinese dialect, domain, risk, or deployment context.

现有中文偏好资源常受规模、领域覆盖和数据验证限制，而人工标注又限制了持续扩展。COIG-P 处理的问题是：在构建流程不引入人工干预的条件下，如何形成足以用于偏好优化和奖励建模的中文优选/劣选监督。其决策边界是为中文查询排列生成候选回答，而不是宣称被选回答对所有人类价值或所有语境都正确。

论文面向中文对齐和中文奖励模型的多任务使用。相关数据面由中文查询、候选回答、优选/劣选标签、领域信息和质量控制元数据组成。它并未证明合成的语言模型判断等同于直接人工偏好，也未证明资源覆盖所有中文变体、领域、风险或部署环境。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
COIG-P releases one million Chinese preference pairs built from 92,000 curated Chinese queries. Multiple LLMs generate and score candidate answers in a pipeline with no human intervention; each usable example retains a query, candidates, chosen/rejected relation, domain, and quality-control information. The contribution is a large synthetic preference object, not a collection of independently human-verified answer keys.

Its feedback contract is model-generated comparison and scoring. The paper reports six task domains, including chat, coding, and mathematics, and uses the resource for direct preference optimization and Chinese reward modeling. This qualifies as preference and reward feedback data because the label expresses an ordering between alternatives, while its synthetic provenance remains essential to interpretation and audit.

COIG-P 发布 100 万条中文偏好对，来自 92,000 条经整理的中文查询。多个语言模型在无人工干预的流程中生成并评分候选回答；一条可用记录保留查询、候选、优选/劣选关系、领域和质量控制信息。其贡献是大规模合成偏好对象，而不是一组经独立人工验证的标准答案。

反馈契约是模型生成的比较与评分。论文报告 6 个任务领域，包括聊天、编程和数学，并将资源用于直接偏好优化和中文奖励建模。标签表达候选之间的排序，因此属于偏好与奖励反馈数据；但合成来源必须始终保留在解释和审计之中。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Curate 92,000 Chinese queries spanning six domains. 2. Use multiple LLMs to generate candidate responses. 3. Use LLM-based judging and quality-control stages to select chosen and rejected answers, with no human intervention reported for the construction pipeline. 4. Store the resulting Chinese preference pairs together with domain and quality-control metadata. 5. Release the dataset for downstream preference optimization and reward-model training.

The paper also trains an 8B Chinese reward model and manually annotates CRBench for evaluation; that manual annotation belongs to the evaluation benchmark, not to COIG-P’s construction pipeline. Reproduction requires the exact query sources, model families and prompts, filtering and judging rules, quality-control thresholds, release revision, and domain assignment. The paper does not disclose every serving configuration in the Card metadata, so those details require source-level verification.

1. 整理覆盖 6 个领域的 92,000 条中文查询。2. 用多个语言模型生成候选回答。3. 通过基于语言模型的裁判和质量控制阶段选择优选与劣选回答；论文报告该构建流程没有人工干预。4. 将形成的中文偏好对与领域、质量控制元数据一并保存。5. 发布数据，供偏好优化和奖励模型训练使用。

论文还训练了一个 8B 中文奖励模型，并为评测人工标注 CRBench；这项人工标注属于评测基准，不属于 COIG-P 的构建流程。复现须固定查询来源、模型家族和提示、筛选与裁判规则、质量阈值、发布版本和领域分配。Card 元数据未披露全部服务配置，相关细节应回到原文核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports one million preference pairs from 92,000 queries and evaluates COIG-P from two directions. Through DPO, Qwen2/2.5 and Infinity-Instruct series obtain 2%–12% gains on AlignBench and outperform the compared Chinese preference datasets in the reported setup. The authors also train an 8B CRM and report robust scoring on their manually annotated CRBench; they state that data constructed by that CRM is comparable in quality to GPT-4o-produced data.

These results support the authors’ tasks, model series, comparison set, and evaluation protocol. They do not show that all synthetic labels are human-aligned, that every domain benefits equally, or that a CRM will transfer to unseen Chinese tasks. The official dataset repository confirms that COIG-P is a released text dataset of 803 MB, but not every construction detail is exposed in its viewer.

论文报告，COIG-P 由 92,000 条查询形成 100 万条偏好对，并从两条路径评测质量。通过 DPO，Qwen2/2.5 和 Infinity-Instruct 系列在 AlignBench 上提升 2%–12%，且在作者报告的设定中优于被比较的中文偏好数据集。作者还训练 8B 中文奖励模型，并报告其在人工标注的 CRBench 上有稳定评分能力；以该模型构造的数据质量与 GPT-4o 构造数据相当。

这些结果只支持作者的任务、模型系列、比较集合和评测协议，不能证明所有合成标签都符合人类偏好、每个领域收益相同，或奖励模型能迁移到未见中文任务。官方数据仓库确认 COIG-P 是已发布的 803 MB 文本数据集，但查看器没有暴露全部构建细节。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest contrast is Chinese preference data collected at smaller scale, narrower coverage, or with direct human annotation as the sole route to validation. COIG-P changes the construction boundary by combining multi-LLM generation, judging, and quality control without human intervention to create 1M Chinese pairs from 92k queries. Its quality signal is not simply volume: it makes synthetic Chinese comparison supervision and its model-based provenance explicit.

The work does not make synthetic labels human judgments, and it does not remove the need for human evaluation. Its contribution is a released pipeline and data object for Chinese preference learning, plus the separate CRBench evaluation described by the paper; those two artifacts must not be conflated.

最接近的对照是规模更小、覆盖更窄，或把直接人工标注作为唯一验证路径的中文偏好数据。COIG-P 改变了构建边界：通过多语言模型生成、裁判和质量控制，在无人工干预下由 92,000 条查询形成 100 万条中文偏好对。其质量信号不只是规模，而是明确保留了合成中文比较监督及其模型来源。

该工作没有把合成标签变成人类判断，也没有取消人工评测的必要。它贡献的是面向中文偏好学习的公开流程和数据对象，以及论文另行描述的 CRBench 评测；两类工件不能混同。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Because multiple LLMs generate and judge the data, model-family preferences, prompt sensitivity, and shared blind spots can be amplified rather than removed. Audit examples by domain and inspect whether a chosen response wins for genuine task quality or for model-recognizable style. Source licensing, contamination with Chinese benchmarks, and query provenance also need checking before reuse.

The paper’s no-human-intervention statement applies to construction, not to its CRBench evaluation. Users should not present COIG-P labels as human annotation. The one-million-pair scale may obscure imbalance across the six domains or duplicated query patterns; measure counts, duplicates, and outcome changes per domain before downstream training.

由于多个语言模型同时生成和裁判数据，模型家族偏好、提示敏感性和共同盲点可能被放大而非消除。应按领域审计样例，检查优选回答是因真正的任务质量获胜，还是因模型容易识别的风格获胜。复用前还须检查来源许可、与中文基准的污染和查询谱系。

论文所说的“无人工干预”适用于构建，不适用于 CRBench 评测。使用者不能把 COIG-P 标签表述为人工标注。100 万对的规模可能掩盖 6 个领域间的不均衡或重复查询模式；下游训练前应按领域统计数量、重复率和结果变化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use COIG-P for Chinese DPO experiments, reward-model training, or audits of synthetic preference pipelines. Preserve the query, both candidates, chosen/rejected relation, domain, and quality-control fields; do not flatten the data to isolated “good answers.” Split evaluation by the six reported domains and compare gains with a human-evaluated set such as CRBench when the task permits.

Before training, deduplicate against local Chinese instruction data and benchmarks, identify the release revision, and inspect samples for licensing and domain fit. The release is not suitable as sole evidence for sensitive human-value decisions, minority-language coverage, or factual accuracy claims, because its construction contract is model-generated.

可将 COIG-P 用于中文 DPO 实验、奖励模型训练，或合成偏好流程审计。应保留查询、两个候选、优选/劣选关系、领域和质量控制字段，不能压缩成孤立的“好回答”。评测应按论文报告的 6 个领域拆分；在任务允许时，可同 CRBench 之类有人类评测的集合对照。

训练前应与本地中文指令数据和基准去重，确认发布版本，并抽样检查许可和领域匹配性。由于构建契约是模型生成的，该发布不适合作为敏感人类价值决策、少数语言覆盖或事实准确性主张的唯一证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Separate the synthetic COIG-P construction pipeline from the manual CRBench evaluation. 2. Verify the 92k-query and 1M-pair counts against the paper and release revision. 3. Sample records across all six domains and inspect candidate provenance and quality-control fields. 4. Test for duplicate queries and benchmark overlap. 5. Report DPO or CRM results by domain, not only as a pooled average.

The practical decision is whether the model-generated ordering is appropriate for a stated Chinese task. If an audit finds that a domain’s labels follow a stylistic shortcut, quarantine that slice instead of interpreting the overall scale as proof of its quality.

1. 严格区分合成的 COIG-P 构建流程与人工的 CRBench 评测。2. 依据论文和发布版本核对 92,000 条查询与 100 万对的数量。3. 覆盖 6 个领域抽样，检查候选谱系和质量控制字段。4. 测试重复查询和基准重叠。5. 按领域报告 DPO 或中文奖励模型结果，而不是只给合并平均值。

实际决策是模型生成的排序是否适合某一明确的中文任务。若审计发现某个领域的标签追随风格捷径，应隔离该切片，而不能把总体规模理解为其质量证明。
